messages:
marco_pm: Heads-up: Large EU partner wants deterministic canary windows + a visible feature flag toggle in Console for their tenants. They also requested minimum 48h notice for any private/dedicated cutover. Thoughts?

anya_eng: We can add a tenant-visible toggle and a scheduled cutover API. Deterministic canary = tenant_id hash -> bucket. ETA: small UI + routing change, ~2 sprints.

tom_sre: Need clear telemetry gates. Recommend: baseline p95+error-rate for 30m, and automated soft-fallback if p95 > 280ms for 5m. Hard rollback if errors spike >4% for 3m.

kate_prodops: Scheduling constraints: ops must approve window and own post-cutover 3h watch. We'll enforce the 48h notice by gating the schedule page.

marco_pm: Decision: implement tenant toggle + schedule API, deterministic hashing, telemetry gates as tom suggested, ops-owned watch. Someone volunteer to write the tiny spec?

anya_eng: I'll write the spec and mockups. Will include routing hash details and EU-local logging.

tom_sre: I'll draft the thresholds and a short runbook.

scheduler-bot: Created task #5912: "spec + UI mock for tenant toggle" and added calendar prototype.

marco_pm: Thanks. We'll track in the roadmap board under "Tenant-gated cutover". Follow-ups in the spec PR.
